name: uig-fork
description: Fork paralleldrive/aidd with runtime-enforced per-ticket UI-GATE

stories.title: Phase 0: Bootstrap the fork and rename aidd → uig
evidence: package.json: name=uig, bin=uig, author=Gerardo I. Ornelas, repo=gerardoiornelas/uig
bin/aidd.js removed; bin/uig.js created (chmod +x, shebang intact)
FORK.md written with fork relationship, divergence policy, quarterly re-sync cadence, trademark guidance
vision.md updated to UI-GATE vision
Existing AIDD commands (discover, task, review, log, commit, user-test, run-test) still resolve to their skill files (untouched)

stories.title: Phase 1: Gate core modules
evidence: lib/gate/state-machine.js — 6 statuses, allow-list transitions, transition() returns {ok, error}
lib/gate/pending-store.js — atomic write, read returns initial state if missing, applyTransition validates against state machine
lib/gate/validation-log.js — JSON + Markdown in one transaction boundary, appendEntry atomically writes both
lib/gate/ticket-resolver.js — reads .uig/tickets.json OR derives from plan.md FEAT-XXX lines, firstOpenTicket skips VALIDATED/SKIPPED, never returns ticket N+1 while N awaits
lib/gate/evidence-hasher.js — SHA-256 of files, hashEvidenceDir by basename, describes missing files
lib/gate/evidence-integrity.js — compares current hashes to recorded, flags mismatches + missing + extra
CONTRIBUTOR-GATE.md written with state machine diagram, pending state shape, log schema, resolver contract, forbidden patterns
5 unit test files: state-machine (12), pending-store (7), validation-log (6), ticket-resolver (13), evidence (7) — 45 tests passing

stories.title: Phase 2: execute wrapper (one-ticket dispatch boundary)
evidence: lib/gate/execute-wrapper.js — exports runExecute(projectRoot, options)
Refuses dispatch while AWAITING_HUMAN with the documented gate message
Resolves one ticket via ticket-resolver.js, never queues ticket N+1
dry-run short-circuits BEFORE any state mutation (fixed bug: previously mutated to EXECUTING before dry-run check)
Mark state EXECUTING at start, AWAITING_HUMAN at success, FAILED on agent/capture error
Captures evidence after agent run, fails gate on capture failure
Appends PENDING row to validation log on success
Implementation does NOT parse agent stdout to decide dispatch
Integration tests: 4 tests passing (dispatch-one, blocks-while-awaiting, no-ticket, already-complete)

stories.title: Phase 3: /validate command and gate-status
evidence: lib/gate/commands.js — registerGateCommands adds execute, validate, gate-status to the CLI
validate FEAT-XXX: confirms pending.ticket matches, status is AWAITING_HUMAN
validate --skip --reason REASON: requires non-empty reason, records SKIPPED, unblocks next
validate (no flag): requires evidence directory + all required files, hashes them, runs integrity check, records VALIDATED
gate-status: shows active ticket, status, waiting duration, last decision, resolver verdict
Tested live: refuses to validate wrong ticket, refuses without evidence, validates with hashes, skip with reason, gate-status shows correct state
Bug fix: renamed subcommand --dry-run to --no-dispatch to avoid collision with parent aidd --dry-run

stories.title: Phase 4: Playwright evidence capture
evidence: lib/gate/evidence-capture.js — captureEvidence({ ticketId, primaryRoute, devServerUrl, ... })
Captures screenshot.png, page.html, console.log into .uig/evidence/FEAT-XXX/
Subscribes to console.error and pageerror during capture window
Returns ok=false with consoleErrors attached if any errors fire (gate stays closed)
Lazy-imports Playwright so projects without it get a clear error message
network.har capture deferred to v2 (out of scope per plan)
Tested in validate-refuses-without-evidence.test.js: 2 tests passing

stories.title: Phase 5: Documentation and portfolio surface update
evidence: FORK.md documents fork relationship, divergence policy, quarterly re-sync cadence, expected conflict zones
CONTRIBUTOR-GATE.md documents state machine, pending state shape, log schema, resolver contract, execute wrapper contract, validate command, forbidden patterns
assets/ui-gate-policy.md vendored — fork-owned copy of the UI-GATE policy (not dependent on portfolio repo)
vision.md updated to UI-GATE mission
.uig/config.json sample + .uig/config.schema.json (JSON Schema) committed to the repo

src/pages/uig.tsx: new 'The three layers' section with methodology/fork/substrate cards, 'Built with UI-GATE' proof block updated to link to gerardoiornelas/uig and preserve '112 atomic features / zero compounding failures' claim

stories.title: E2E gate flow on a 3-ticket demo project
evidence: Live E2E run on /tmp/uig-e2e-demo with 3-ticket plan: scaffold, gate-status (IDLE), execute (dry-run no state change), execute real (AWAITING_HUMAN FEAT-001), execute again (GATE_BLOCKED exit 2), validate --skip --reason (SKIPPED), execute (FEAT-002), validate without evidence (refused exit 2), validate with evidence (VALIDATED + SHA-256 hashes recorded), execute (FEAT-003), validate --skip (SKIPPED), execute (ALREADY_COMPLETE exit 2)
validation.log.json + validation.log.md both written, schema-consistent
All 51 unit + integration tests passing (vitest run lib/gate/__tests__/)
